verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents issuing temporary JWTs with a 30-second TTL for its APIs, and API-key management through the dg CLI. Together these give a short-lived, time-limited credential an agent could use. Nothing in the pack shows permission scopes, roles, or per-key restrictions, so least-privilege scoping is unproven. Missing for 10: documented permission scopes/roles on API keys or tokens, guidance on agent-specific credentials, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: Generates a temporary JSON Web Token (JWT) with a 30-second TTL (Time To Live) for Deepgram APIs.
Manage projects, API keys, team members, and usage with the dg CLI.
